body:
I woke up one morning, feeling the need to experience experiences. I felt like i have done nothing with my teenage life, and that everyone else was having fun and I was not.
So I researched gravol. Something light, to start off my experimentation with drugs. I did it with 2 friends. 10 pills each.
Sunny day. I felt the sensation of excitement at first, not knowing when the drug will pop in. When it did I was staring at a doodle on the red wall. It was vibrant and vivid. Almost ecstatic. Terrifying.
We went into a dark storage room. I saw people all around me, and i heard voices. They were close to me. Hovering. The room i was in looked a lot bigger than it was. I looked back to the other side, and i saw an alien towards me. We went back to the apartment room. We were all totally distracted from reality, not talking to each other unless we thought we heard something. Nauseous. The walls looked like bacteria bubbling. The carpet was flowing. A cartoonish like sunshine formed within the lights of the ceiling, talking to me. Polite. Too kind...suspicious...
Then I barfed.
